item.title: Javier Hernández defends Michael Carrick, calls on Man Utd players to ‘give your life for this club’
item.description: Javier Hernández won two Premier League titles with Manchester United -Credit:James Gill - Danehouse/Getty Images Former Mexico international and longtime Manchester United striker Javier Hernández launched into an impassioned defense of former teammate and current Red Devils boss Michael Carrick on Sunday. Prior to their dramatic 4-4 home draw against Aston Villa, which saw Carrick’s side come back from two goals down twice to secure a valuable point ahead of the international break, Hernández gave his view on the United boss and who he believes is to blame for their abysmal season to date. Speaking to Sky Sports , the 38-year-old said of Carrick, “I am confident. I am a believer that if sometimes the decisions cannot be in your own way, and I'm not saying because I'm completely in favor; I'm saying in the world, I'm more in favour of like, if a decision is taken already, instead of staying complaining, go with it, and let's see if it was right or not, because then time is going to say. item.title: Why Patriots should be concerned about Drake Maye after three interceptions vs. Packers
item.description: Why Patriots should be concerned about Drake Maye after three interceptions vs. Packers originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The New England Patriots lost to the Green Bay Packers in a brutal Week 9 blowout loss. While the struggles of Christian Gonzalez were alarming, one of the more worrying things from this game was Drake Maye's performance. After seemingly getting back on track following a rough start to the season, Maye has regressed again, throwing three more interceptions against the Packers during Sunday's loss. ESPN's Mike Reiss believes that it's time to be worried about Maye, as his interception problem should have the Patriots and their fans concerned. Patriots should be concerned about Drake Maye's INT problem "The Patriots haven't had a positive turnover differential in a game this season and are now minus-11 on the year," Reiss writes. "So there is a high level of concern, especially for a team hoping to make a deep playoff run." Maye threw three interceptions against the Packers in Week 9, and now has 11 total picks on the season. He has already surpassed his eight-interception total from a year ago. He's clearly struggling more than normal, and that's even though his 2,282 passing yards are sixth in the NFL, his 18 passing touchdowns are tied for fourth, and his 73.7 QBR is fifth-best in the league. But his turnover problem is really hurting the Patriots' odds to win these games where his turnover problems really come into play. MORE : Mike Vrabel gives blunt assessment of Christian Gonzalez's struggles The Patriots are 5-4 on the season, and if Maye can't figure things out, they might be in real jeopardy of falling out of a playoff position. While New England might still make the playoffs, the inconsistency of Maye with these interceptions makes it hard to believe in this team come the playoffs. Seeing Maye fix this interception problem might be the difference in this team being able to go on a deep playoff run or not. After another brutal performance, throwing three interceptions in one game, it's hard to believe in Maye right now. Patriots fans and the team should be concerned about Maye, as his turnover struggles are really hurting the team right now and could become a major problem if they don't go away soon. item.title: ⌚ Galo race against time to get players fit for Copa Sul-Americana final
item.description: ⌚ Galo race against time to get players fit for Copa Sul-Americana final Atlético-MG have just five games left in 2026 and need to get several injured players fit again quickly. The main goal is to be at full strength for the CONMEBOL Sudamericana final against Boca Juniors on November 21 in Barranquilla, Colombia. In the 1–1 draw with Grêmio in the Copa do Brasil, Fred and Cassierra came on in the second half but were still short of full fitness. Coach Eduardo Domínguez confirmed that Fred played “through the pain,” as his left thigh injury had not yet healed. Cassierra is also coming back from a thigh injury and played fewer than 30 minutes. Ruan Tressoldi and Maycon, who had already been cleared to play, remained on the bench against Grêmio. Atlético still have three players receiving treatment: Victor Hugo, with a right thigh adductor problem, Reinier, with a left thigh injury, and Thiago Borbas, with a right thigh injury. Borbas is the closest to returning to training with the squad. Lyanco also missed the game against Grêmio. In addition to discomfort in a tendon in his left foot, he was rested due to serious personal issues. Galo are now preparing to face Mirassol on the 14th, followed by the final against Boca. item.title: Brewers radio host Dominic Cotroneo leaving WTMJ
item.description: Dominic Cotroneo, who's been a fixture on Milwaukee Brewers pregame and postgame coverage since midway through the 2022 season, announced on X that he was leaving WTMJ radio, noting that the maneuver was "100% my decision" and that he doesn't have a fixed plan for what comes next. "I wish them nothing but the best; they gave me an opportunity in the 2022 season to be the new postgame radio host, and that's not an honor I take lightly," Cotroneo said Monday, Nov. 9. "I did the best that I could, and I think WTMJ appreciated my efforts. Sometimes it's OK to say goodbye." Cotroneo, 32, has a number of irons in the fire. He frequently offers Brewers coverage on his YouTube channel and has been working independently on the Service Time podcast, a deep dive into the history of labor in Major League Baseball – a timely topic given the swirling winds around an MLB lockout likely beginning Dec. 1. With so much unknown for next season for myself and the industry, I wanted to build on a YouTube base that grew quickly during the postseason. I can create baseball content on my own volition and prepare for spring training (whenever that is) — Dominic Cotroneo (@Dom_Cotroneo) November 9, 2026 Cotroneo's coverage with WTMJ included "Brewers Extra Innings," the station's postgame call-in show, and later included "Brewers Warmup" before network pregame coverage, the "Brewers Weekly" program on Thursday nights and written coverage on the radio station's website. WTMJ has been the flagship station for Brewers game broadcasts for almost the entirety of the franchise's time in Milwaukee. He has also operated as the "talent stats" guru for Brewers.TV broadcasts and filled a similar role for TBS, often doing in-game research to supplement broadcasts. Cotroneo makes no bones about his desire to move into an MLB play-by-play role. His previous experience as a minor-league announcer included stops in Orem, Utah; Kinston, North Carolina; and Corpus Christi, Texas. His father, Vince, called MLB games for 32 years, with tenures working for the Houston Astros, Texas Rangers and Oakland Athletics. Vince cut his teeth in a similar role to the one Dominic holds now, working alongside legendary broadcaster Milo Hamilton. "I don't know what the future holds for any of this, between the lockout, play-by-play jobs … it gets to a point where you need to take a leap of faith," Dominic said. "It doesn't mean I'm going to leave Milwaukee or leave this market." This article originally appeared on Milwaukee Journal Sentinel: Brewers radio host Dominic Cotroneo leaving WTMJ

item.title: Lakers bench's reaction to Duncan Robinson says everything about Pistons sharpshooter's signature skill
item.description: Lakers bench's reaction to Duncan Robinson says everything about Pistons sharpshooter's signature skill originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Duncan Robinson is no NBA superstar. But his gifts — from his connectivity as a playmaker to his glittering basketball IQ — have made him a useful player to the Pistons in recent years. Robinson's calling card through seven years in the league is his shooting. He's less a man than a trebuchet beyond the arc, known to rise above late closeouts to inflict damage upon opposition defenses. He has done that in droves in 2026-27, producing career-best figures for 6-3 Detroit. In the Pistons' loss to the 121-116 loss to the Lakers on Sunday, Robinson's penchant for triples — and the attention it received on Los Angeles' scouting report — became immediately evident to those watching on. Here's what you need to know. DAZN Lakers bench's reaction to Duncan Robinson says everything about Pistons sharpshooter's signature skill Robinson found a bit of daylight towards the end of Sunday's game, shedding Walker Kessler before fielding a pass from Kevin Huerter and firing from beyond the arc. Predictably, the triple nestled calmly into the net. Robinson was largely ineffective from distance on Sunday, only finding his mark on three of 11 attempts. Nevertheless, Los Angeles bench's animated reaction to the miscue — spearheaded by a leaping Jake LaRavia, a frustrated Jarred Vanderbilt and the typically-stoic Sandro Mamukelashvili sinking into his seat after the ball whistled through the hoop — indicated that JJ Redick's side was, indeed, worried about Robinson's shooting prowess. Watch the Lakers bench when Kessler leaves Robinson to help... https://t.co/vUMv3QL0ZM — Coach Gibson Pyper (@HalfCourtHoops) November 9, 2026 It's easy to see why. Robinson is averaging a career-best 18.2 points per game this season, starring in an increased role in J.B. Bickerstaff's setup. He ranks fifth in the league in three-pointers made (38) and is shooting a career-high from deep 45.2 percent. Los Angeles' response might have seemed a bit exaggerated given Robinson's relative standing around the league. But make no mistakes about it; Robinson deserves the attention. item.title: Which Bengals have won NFL MVP award? Is Joe Burrow next?
item.description: Cincinnati Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow is considered by many to be the frontrunner for this season's AP NFL Most Valuable Player award, which would be his first. Burrow is on pace for more than 5,000 passing yards and 55 passing touchdowns. Burrow had a career-best 4,918 passing yards with 43 passing TDs in 2024. Only two Bengals have won the award: QB Boomer Esiason in 1988, and QB Ken Anderson in 1981. During analysis on NFL Network ahead of the Bengals' NFL Week 9 win against Atlanta in Madrid, Pro Football Hall of Famer Kurt Warner said he thinks Burrow, Warner's NFL MVP pick, can lead the team back to the Super Bowl. Joe Burrow would be the third Bengals QB to win AP NFL MVP award. Buffalo Bills quarterback Josh Allen had been considered the frontrunner for the award before Burrow's impressive recent run of 16 passing TDs over the past four games. Burrow was one of five finalists for the 2024 award, which Allen won . Burrow finished the 2024 season as the league leader in passing yards and touchdown passes . Burrow added a rushing TD against Atlanta, and reacted with a unique celebration . Before the game, Burrow greeted Spanish soccer star Ferran Torres. After the game, Burrow said Ja'Marr Chase "was unbelievable" against Atlanta, swapped jerseys with Real Madrid goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois, and told reporters he'd love to play in the first NFL game in Tokyo. item.title: Lexi Thompson believes WTGL will help grow the game of golf
item.description: LPGA golfers pose for a photo during WTGL Media Day at SoFi Center in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida on September 20, 2026. | USA TODAY Network via Reuters Co The future is here. WTGL kicked off on Sunday, Los Angeles Golf Club defeated New York , and it is already back in action. Tuesday will see L.A. take on Motor City Golf Club, Lexi Thompson’s team. Women’s golf has grown so much over the last 20 years and that time span just about directly coincides with Lexi’s professional career. Everyone remembers her making her U.S. Open debut in 2007 at the age of 12, and in the time since she has piled up the wins, titles, and now has a spot in the startup league… while pregnant to boot. Lexi was kind enough to take some time to join me for a conversation about WTGL on Monday. You can watch it in its entirety below. As noted I find Lexi to be such an important figure in the world of golf at large. She has been such a trailblazer in the game, and she continues to be with WTGL in general, but that she is taking it on while carrying a child is an entirely different level of impressiveness. Lexi and her fellow WTGL players have all talked about what an opportunity the league represents for them and the next generation. In Lexi’s case she is quite literally carrying that generation to and through her WTGL experience. This year may mark the first literal season of WTGL, but it has been in the works for a long time if you really think about it. What the Lexi Thompsons of the world have done, many of whom share the WTGL experience with her, over the course of their careers has helped to open the door of possibility for all involved. Here’s to seeing what they and those they continue to inspire can do next. Tuesday’s match between Motor City Golf Club and Los Angeles Golf Club can be seen on Ion at 7pm CT.

item.title: Barcelona make enquiry for Bayern Munich defender ahead of January window – report
item.description: Barcelona make enquiry for Bayern Munich defender ahead of January window – report In a major development, Florian Plettenberg of Sky Germany reports that Barcelona have made an enquiry for Bayern Munich defensive mainstay Jonathan Tah. The Blaugrana are scouring the market for an experienced defender to partner Pau Cubarsi at the heart of the defence and see the German international as an appealing target. Tah back on Barcelona’s radar Tah is a name very familiar to Barcelona, considering that they had shown a strong interest in signing him back in 2025, when his contract at Bayer Leverkusen was expiring. The La Liga champions explored the possibility of a move but decided not to sign him, and he ended up moving to Bayern Munich. Since joining the Bundesliga title holders, the 30-year-old has grown into a mainstay at the back, racking up 67 appearances in which he has three goals and assists each. Back on Barcelona’s radar. (Photo by Alexander Hassenstein/Getty Images) As per the report, Barcelona director Deco and manager Hansi Flick continue to rate Tah highly, and therefore, an enquiry has now been made regarding his availability. January move not an option However, the journalist states that, as things stand, a January move for Tah is not seen as viable for Barcelona. The German international is settled well at Bayern Munich, who themselves have no intentions of letting the centre-back leave the club in January. As such, Barça’s interest is unlikely to proceed beyond the enquiry that has been made for the 30-year-old defender, whose contract at the Allianz Arena runs until the summer of 2029. Bayern will not sell Tah in January. item.description: Across September and October, NIL Go cleared more than $190 million worth of NIL deals, the College Sports Commission announced Monday morning. That’s the second-highest total for a two-month period since NIL Go’s launch last year. Between Sept. 1 and Oct. 31, a total of 10,092 NIL deal were cleared by the system with an aggregate value of $192.62 million, according to the CSC. On the other side, 581 deals worth $20.21 million were not cleared. The other 3,493 deals were with non-associated entities with a value of $52.09 million – the highest total value for non-associated deals during the 2026 calendar year. The CSC said it took action on 175 NIL deals per day during September and October, and 48% of those deals had resolutions within a week of filling out all required fields. There has also been an increase in “complexity” of submitted deals, which includes clarity about the funding source of deals and money from schools used to fund a third-party “sponsor” that, otherwise, is not seeking a profit. I think what we’ve been able to do really well is every practice, every pregame skate, every lunch, dinner, every time we hang out, we still have that camaraderie and that joy to be at the rink. But at the end of the day, we’ve got to be better.” Although there have been rumblings that Chicago was considering a coaching change, multiple reports, including one from The Athletic’s Scott Powers, indicated that the team is not considering replacing head coach Jeff Blashill at this point. “It’s a hard pill to swallow. At the end of the day we got our butts kicked,” Blashill said of the latest loss. “We’ve got to make this kind of a bottom point in the year. We have to find a way to claw our way out of this.” The Blackhawks haven’t advanced to the Stanley Cup Playoffs since 2019-20 and look closer to landing a high lottery pick than earning a postseason berth this year. “It’s not rocket science. It’s not good enough,” Bedard added. “We know that. We’ve got a few days of practice to get better. Try to just wipe this and start 0-0 and start winning some games. There’s belief in the room. There’s belief in everyone from players, coaches, management. We believe in what everyone is trying to do.” Following Saturday’s loss, the Blackhawks are off until Thursday, when they begin a four-game homestand against the Buffalo Sabres at United Center.
